These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.

Independent research directory · Begun October 19, 2026 · Updated October 21, 2026 · Entries include peoples, nations, communities, historical terms, and overlapping names. Entry counts are not a count of distinct nations. Source guides are starting points for further research. Saved entries stay in this browser.
